title: Hy Clark's band and its Latin members
summary: Hy Clark's band featured Latin musicians playing American music.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What was Hi Clark? You said it was a band, but --

Hi Clark was a trombone player. He used to be with the before. He's from down that way, somewhere around there. And he was not such a hell of a trombone player, but he wasn't bad, either. But he was a man with a good contact, you know what I mean? One of those straight-up men, you know what I mean? I guess he had leader connections.
And he created this band around some Latin musicians, so he had about four or five Latin musicians.

There was another trumpet player in there called -- they used to call him Chico, a Puerto Rican trumpet player. And they had a guy by the name of Napoleon, played tenor, from Santo Domingo. Who -- he had a West Indian guitar
player named Lufu. He had another (unintelligible).
But was he playing American music?
